source_texts:
Jesus Is Tested in the Wilderness
1 Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, left the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness, 2 where for forty days he was tempted[a] by the devil. He ate nothing during those days, and at the end of them he was hungry.

3 The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, tell this stone to become bread.”

1 Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone.’[b]”

5 The devil led him up to a high place and showed him in an instant all the kingdoms of the world. 6 And he said to him, “I will give you all their authority and splendor; it has been given to me, and I can give it to anyone I want to. 7 If you worship me, it will all be yours.”

8 Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve him only.’[c]”

9 The devil led him to Jerusalem and had him stand on the highest point of the temple. “If you are the Son of God,” he said, “throw yourself down from here. 10 For it is written:

“‘He will command his angels concerning you
to guard you carefully;
11 they will lift you up in their hands,
so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.’[d]”

12 Jesus answered, “It is said: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’[e]”

13 When the devil had finished all this tempting, he left him until an opportune time.

Jesus Rejected at Nazareth
14 Jesus returned to Galilee in the power of the Spirit, and news about him spread through the whole countryside. 15 He was teaching in their synagogues, and everyone praised him.

16 He went to Nazareth, where he had been brought up, and on the Sabbath day he went into the synagogue, as was his custom. He stood up to read, 17 and the scroll of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. Unrolling it, he found the place where it is written:

18 “The Spirit of the Lord is on me,
because he has anointed me
to proclaim good news to the poor.
He has sent me to proclaim freedom for the prisoners
and recovery of sight for the blind,
to set the oppressed free,
19 to proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor.”[f]

20 Then he rolled up the scroll, gave it back to the attendant and sat down. The eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fastened on him. 21 He began by saying to them, “Today this scripture is fulfilled in your hearing.”

22 All spoke well of him and were amazed at the gracious words that came from his lips. “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?” they asked.

23 Jesus said to them, “Surely you will quote this proverb to me: ‘Physician, heal yourself!’ And you will tell me, ‘Do here in your hometown what we have heard that you did in Capernaum.’”

24 “Truly I tell you,” he continued, “no prophet is accepted in his hometown. 25 I assure you that there were many widows in Israel in Elijah’s time, when the sky was shut for three and a half years and there was a severe famine throughout the land. 26 Yet Elijah was not sent to any of them, but to a widow in Zarephath in the region of Sidon. 27 And there were many in Israel with leprosy[g] in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed—only Naaman the Syrian.”

28 All the people in the synagogue were furious when they heard this. 29 They got up, drove him out of the town, and took him to the brow of the hill on which the town was built, in order to throw him off the cliff. 30 But he walked right through the crowd and went on his way.

Jesus Drives Out an Impure Spirit
31 Then he went down to Capernaum, a town in Galilee, and on the Sabbath he taught the people. 32 They were amazed at his teaching, because his words had authority.

33 In the synagogue there was a man possessed by a demon, an impure spirit. He cried out at the top of his voice, 34 “Go away! What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are—the Holy One of God!”

35 “Be quiet!” Jesus said sternly. “Come out of him!” Then the demon threw the man down before them all and came out without injuring him.

36 All the people were amazed and said to each other, “What words these are! With authority and power he gives orders to impure spirits and they come out!” 37 And the news about him spread throughout the surrounding area.

Jesus Heals Many
38 Jesus left the synagogue and went to the home of Simon. Now Simon’s mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever, and they asked Jesus to help her. 39 So he bent over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. She got up at once and began to wait on them.

40 At sunset, the people brought to Jesus all who had various kinds of sickness, and laying his hands on each one, he healed them. 41 Moreover, demons came out of many people, shouting, “You are the Son of God!” But he rebuked them and would not allow them to speak, because they knew he was the Messiah.

42 At daybreak, Jesus went out to a solitary place. The people were looking for him and when they came to where he was, they tried to keep him from leaving them. 43 But he said, “I must proclaim the good news of the kingdom of God to the other towns also, because that is why I was sent.” 44 And he kept on preaching in the synagogues of Judea.
translations:
耶稣在旷野受试
1 耶稣充满圣灵、离开约旦河、被圣灵引导到旷野。 2 在那里,他被魔鬼试探了四十天,在那些日子里,他什么也没吃,最后他饿了。

3 撒下9 魔鬼对他说、你若是神的儿子、就叫这石头作面包。

1 耶稣回答说,“上面写着,‘人不能单靠面包生存。

5 魔鬼带他到高处,立刻向他展示了世上的各王国。 6 撒上9 耶稣对他说、我必赐给你他们的一切权柄和光荣. 这是赐给我的、我可以赐给谁也愿意。 7 若你敬拜我,那全是你的。

8 耶稣回答说、有记载说、你们要奉耶和华你们的 神、只奉他。

9 魔鬼带他到耶路撒冷,叫他站在庙顶上。 他说:“如果你是神的儿子,就从这儿下去吧。 10 因为有记载的说、他必吩咐他的使者、在你们身上、谨守你们。
11 他们必将你举起来,以致你不能撞上石头。

12 耶稣回答说、有人说、不可试用耶和华你的 神。

13 撒下9:7 魔鬼把这一切诱惑都作完、就离开他、直到有的时候
14 耶稣在灵的力中回到加利利,使他的消息传遍了整个乡村。 15 他在他们的犹太会堂里讲课,众人都赞美他。

16 他到了 Nazareth,在那里长大。 安息日,他按自己的习俗进入犹太会堂,站起来看书, 17 耶和华将先知以赛亚的书卷递给他,他把书卷折开,找到了写在书上的地方。

18 耶和华的灵在我身上,因他使我为穷人传福音、为囚犯宣扬自由、为瞎子恢复视力、使受压迫的人自由、
19 宣布耶和华的恩赐年。

20 他把书卷卷翻起来,交给侍者,坐下来, synagogue里所有的人都盯着他。 21 创8 耶稣说、今日这经在你们的听中成就了。

22 他们都对他讲得很好,惊奇地听见他从嘴里说的话。 他们问:“这不是约瑟的儿子吗?”

23 耶和华对他们说、你们必将这谚语传给我说、医者、治好自己。 你们必告诉我、你们在你们的家乡、当你们在 Capernaum所作的事、我们听见了。

24 “我实在告诉你们,”他继续说,“没有一个先知在家乡被接受。 25 我向你们保证,在以利雅时代,以色列有许多寡妇。 那时,天空被关了三年半,全地饥荒甚重。 26 但以利亚不是差遣到他们中间的,乃是差遣给西顿的 Zarephath 的寡妇。 27 在預言者以利沙的時代,以色列有许多人患了瘟疫,但其中沒有一個被清净,只有敘利亞人納曼。

28 犹太会堂的众人听见这话,就发怒了。 29 他们起来,将他赶出城里,带到城里建造的山顶上,要把他从悬崖上扔下来。 30 耶稣驱赶出一个不洁净的灵
31 他下到加利利的 Capernaum城,在安息日教训百姓。 32 他们对他的教训感到惊奇,因为他的话有权威。

33 在犹太会堂里,有一个被恶魔所支配的人,一个不洁净的灵,他大声喊道, 34 “走吧,纳撒勒的耶稣,你想要我们什么呢?你来毁灭我们吗?我知道你是谁,神圣的!”

35 耶稣严厉地说,“离开他吧!”然后,恶魔把那人丢在众人面前,没有伤害他,就出来了。

36 众民都惊奇,彼此说:“这些话是什么!他用威权和力量命令邪恶的灵,他们出来!” 37 耶稣医治了许多人
38 耶稣离开犹太会堂,到西门的家里去。 西蒙的岳母得了高烧,他们请耶稣帮助她。 39 于是他弯腰对着她,责备发烧,发烧就离开了她。 她立刻起来,等着他们。

40 到了日落的时候,众人将有各种病的人都带到耶稣那里。 耶稣把手放在每个人身上,医治他们。 41 太5:9 又有许多恶魔从百姓中出来、喊道、你是神的儿子。

42 耶稣在黎明的时候,出去到一个孤儿的地方。 百姓正在寻找他。 他们到了他那里,设法阻止他离开他们。 43 撒上9:8 他说、我必须向各城传出神的国的福音、就是因为我被差遣来的。 44 他在犹太的犹太会堂继续传教。
